name: Sedgwick County, KS
findings: Sedgwick County has 1,625 nonprofit organizations. 655 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 514 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sedgwick County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Sedgwick County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 32 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few economic development organizations list membership
observations.text: 8 economic development organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 22 would.

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through economic development groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.text: 120 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
